planning_effect.rationale: A five-point gain in mean event percentile is the smallest lift worth a target-prioritization claim.

min_disease_count.rationale: Pilot adjudication burden versus proportion precision.

observation_lag_months.rationale: Publication and indexing lag before a window counts as observed.

ANY_PRIMARY_ENDPOINT_AMBIGUITY_FRACTION.metric_definition: Unique adjudicated event cases that are AMBIGUOUS or UNRESOLVED on any primary-endpoint dimension, divided by adjudicated event cases (union, not component maximum)
ANY_PRIMARY_ENDPOINT_AMBIGUITY_FRACTION.rationale: At most one in five cases may depend on unresolved adjudication; above two in five the endpoint is not constructible as specified.

AGREEMENT_AC1_MIN_OVER_GATED_TASKS.metric_definition: Minimum over the four gated tasks of the Gwet AC1 point estimate on the duplicate-reviewed set (retest set if rules were revised)
AGREEMENT_AC1_MIN_OVER_GATED_TASKS.rationale: 0.6-0.8 is the conventional 'substantial' band; 0.70 is its midpoint. Below 0.60 the labels are not reproducible enough to benchmark.

AGREEMENT_AC1_LOWER90_MIN_OVER_GATED_TAS.metric_definition: Minimum over the four gated tasks of the lower one-sided 90% bound of AC1 (case bootstrap BCa, 10,000 replicates, keyed seed) on the duplicate-reviewed set (retest set if rules were revised)
AGREEMENT_AC1_LOWER90_MIN_OVER_GATED_TAS.rationale: Stops a lucky point estimate at n near 30 from passing the agreement gate.

DUPLICATE_REVIEW_COVERAGE_RATIO.metric_definition: Duplicate-reviewed event cases divided by min(N, max(30, ceil(0.30 N)))
DUPLICATE_REVIEW_COVERAGE_RATIO.rationale: Procedural completeness; an under-sized duplicate review cannot support any agreement claim.

NON_EVENT_AUDIT_COMPLETION_RATIO.metric_definition: Completed symmetric non-event audits divided by min(100, max(50, N_event))
NON_EVENT_AUDIT_COMPLETION_RATIO.rationale: Procedural completeness of the symmetric audit.

NON_EVENT_DUPLICATE_REVIEW_COVERAGE_RATI.metric_definition: Duplicate-reviewed non-event cases divided by min(N_non_event, max(30, ceil(0.30 N_non_event)))
NON_EVENT_DUPLICATE_REVIEW_COVERAGE_RATI.rationale: Procedural completeness of the non-event duplicate review.

REQUIRED_FIELD_AVAILABILITY.metric_definition: Available cells divided by scope cells, where scope = selected diseases x all registry fields and availability uses the registry predicate
REQUIRED_FIELD_AVAILABILITY.rationale: Missing CRITICAL fields already void the affected cases; this bounds the remaining erosion of nuisance and endpoint inputs.

SOURCE_FAMILY_KINDS_PRESENT.metric_definition: Number of the four mandatory source-family kinds present with an identified historical release
SOURCE_FAMILY_KINDS_PRESENT.rationale: All four families are structurally required.

ANCESTRY_METADATA_COVERAGE.metric_definition: Adjudicated event cases with ancestry metadata from an identified source, divided by adjudicated event cases
ANCESTRY_METADATA_COVERAGE.rationale: Needed to state the applicability of any claim and to apply matched-ancestry LD in novelty adjudication.

SHARED_PIPELINE_FRACTION_PRIMARY.metric_definition: Primary positives whose only outcome evidence path shares a curation-pipeline family with a Past input, divided by primary positives
SHARED_PIPELINE_FRACTION_PRIMARY.rationale: Replaces the undefined 'material coupling' wording with a number.

UNKNOWN_SAMPLE_OVERLAP_FRACTION.metric_definition: Primary positives whose overlap with pre-T cohorts is UNKNOWN, divided by primary positives
UNKNOWN_SAMPLE_OVERLAP_FRACTION.rationale: Replaces 'within the frozen acceptable policy' with a number.

PRIMARY_ELIGIBLE_FRACTION.metric_definition: Event families with a primary assignment class divided by adjudicated gene-assignable event families
PRIMARY_ELIGIBLE_FRACTION.rationale: Below half, the gene-level endpoint rests on a minority of discoveries; the locus-level redesign is then preferred.

AUTHOR_NEAREST_FRACTION.metric_definition: Event families whose best assignment is AUTHOR_NAMED or NEAREST_GENE, divided by adjudicated event families
AUTHOR_NEAREST_FRACTION.rationale: A majority of attention-sensitive labels signals label circularity.

HIGH_SPECIFICITY_POSITIVE_COUNT.metric_definition: Number of NOVEL-STRICT primary-positive event families in the pilot
HIGH_SPECIFICITY_POSITIVE_COUNT.rationale: Minimum needed to estimate the events-per-disease distribution and within-disease SD used by the power screen.

HYPOTHESIS_FREE_DISCOVERY_FRACTION.metric_definition: Adjudicated event families whose discovery design is GENOME_WIDE, EXOME_WIDE or BIOBANK_WIDE, divided by adjudicated event families
HYPOTHESIS_FREE_DISCOVERY_FRACTION.rationale: If most discoveries are targeted, the hypothesis-free primary endpoint misrepresents the discovery process.

LABEL_FEATURE_METHOD_COUPLING_FRACTION.metric_definition: Primary positives whose assignment method family also feeds the planned biology block, divided by primary positives

ATTENTION_ASSIGNMENT_ASSOC_UPPER95.metric_definition: Upper 95% bound of |Spearman rho| between the assigned gene's attention percentile and the AUTHOR_NAMED/NEAREST_GENE indicator (policy in the adjudication config)
ATTENTION_ASSIGNMENT_ASSOC_UPPER95.rationale: The gate must show the association is below a moderate correlation, not merely non-significant.

LABEL_RESOLUTION_BIAS_UPPER95.metric_definition: Upper 95% bound of |Spearman rho| between the nearest gene's attention percentile and the primary-resolvable indicator over all post-T event families
LABEL_RESOLUTION_BIAS_UPPER95.rationale: Same bound as the assignment audit; checks whether high-specificity resolution itself follows attention.

LOCUS_TO_MANY_GENE_FRACTION.metric_definition: Primary-positive event families with more than one primary gene, divided by primary-positive event families
LOCUS_TO_MANY_GENE_FRACTION.rationale: Above a quarter, gene-level credit becomes a locus-level question.

PRE_T_COHORT_REUSE_FRACTION.metric_definition: NOVEL-STRICT primary positives whose discovery sample includes a cohort analysed genome-wide for the disease before T, divided by primary positives
PRE_T_COHORT_REUSE_FRACTION.rationale: Above half, strict novelty is dominated by power maturation of existing cohorts.

NUISANCE_MEAN_POSITIVE_PERCENTILE.metric_definition: Disease-macro mean over event-bearing pilot diseases of M_d (EVENT_RANK_PERCENTILE_V1, out-of-fold) under the nuisance-only arm
NUISANCE_MEAN_POSITIVE_PERCENTILE.rationale: Headroom (1 - mean) must be at least twice the 0.05 planning effect.

NUISANCE_MEDIAN_POSITIVE_PERCENTILE.metric_definition: Median over pilot primary-positive event families of the family credit pct(f) (out-of-fold) under the nuisance-only arm
NUISANCE_MEDIAN_POSITIVE_PERCENTILE.rationale: A median positive already in the top 1% leaves almost no rank space.

NUISANCE_TOP1_POSITIVE_FRACTION.metric_definition: Pilot primary-positive event families with family credit pct(f) >= 0.99 under the nuisance-only arm, divided by those families
NUISANCE_TOP1_POSITIVE_FRACTION.rationale: Saturation at the top of the list.

NUISANCE_ADEQUACY_MARGIN.metric_definition: Combined nuisance out-of-fold metric minus best single-family out-of-fold metric
NUISANCE_ADEQUACY_MARGIN.rationale: A comparator weaker than its own best component is under-fitted. The BIG 0F learner is never changed after pilot labels exist, so failure is REDESIGN, not a re-run.

MEDIAN_EVENT_CURATION_MINUTES.metric_definition: Median reviewer minutes per event case (first review)
MEDIAN_EVENT_CURATION_MINUTES.rationale: Above two hours per case the confirmatory label construction is not operable at the required disease counts.

NON_EVENT_TO_EVENT_TIME_RATIO_MIN.metric_definition: Median non-event audit minutes divided by median event audit minutes
NON_EVENT_TO_EVENT_TIME_RATIO_MIN.rationale: A far cheaper non-event audit suggests the audit is not being applied symmetrically.

NON_EVENT_TO_EVENT_TIME_RATIO_MAX.metric_definition: Median non-event audit minutes divided by median event audit minutes
NON_EVENT_TO_EVENT_TIME_RATIO_MAX.rationale: A far costlier non-event audit makes symmetric auditing of the confirmatory universe infeasible.

EVENT_BEARING_DISEASE_FRACTION.metric_definition: Selected pilot diseases with at least one NOVEL-STRICT primary positive, divided by selected pilot diseases
EVENT_BEARING_DISEASE_FRACTION.rationale: Prevents a GO driven by a few event-rich diseases.

OUTCOME_DISCOVERY_RECALL.metric_definition: Families found by the frozen procedure divided by families found by either the procedure or the broad recall audit
OUTCOME_DISCOVERY_RECALL.source_artifact: outcome-discovery recall audit (harness artifact; schema IMPLEMENTATION-PENDING)
OUTCOME_DISCOVERY_RECALL.rationale: The raw event universe must be close to complete for selection rules to be meaningful.

FRAME_COVERAGE_FRACTION.metric_definition: Share of frame(T) diseases with HistoricalGeneticSearchCoverage >= MODERATE
FRAME_COVERAGE_FRACTION.rationale: Selection predicate P_cov: below half, E1-NOVEL-STRICT is undefined for most of the frame.

FRAME_COVERED_DISEASE_COUNT.metric_definition: Number of frame(T) diseases with coverage >= MODERATE
FRAME_COVERED_DISEASE_COUNT.rationale: Selection predicate P_cov: 15 pilot diseases plus at least 45 for the untouched pool before the power screen.

MEAN_RAW_CANDIDATES_PER_COVERED_DISEASE.metric_definition: Raw candidate event families (not PRE_T_LOCUS) per frame_cov(T) disease in (T, T+H]
MEAN_RAW_CANDIDATES_PER_COVERED_DISEASE.rationale: Selection predicate P_evt: 60 families over at most 15 diseases.

POWER_POOL_SUFFICIENCY.metric_definition: Untouched pool U minus the DLVS reservation N_DLVS minus F_req at the PLANNING scenario of the Stage A power screen
POWER_POOL_SUFFICIENCY.rationale: GO boundary of the frozen scenario family; the reservation keeps enough untouched diseases after the Stage B DLVS draw (power policy §2).

POWER_POOL_OPTIMISTIC_FLOOR.metric_definition: Untouched pool U minus the DLVS reservation N_DLVS minus F_req at the OPTIMISTIC scenario of the Stage A power screen
POWER_POOL_OPTIMISTIC_FLOOR.rationale: NO_GO boundary of the frozen scenario family: if even the optimistic scenario cannot be powered from the untouched pool, V0 confirmation is infeasible (power policy §2).
